push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 6.6, your 4th worst match performance. I believe in you as much as I did this morning.

DID WELL
+ 6 tackles attempted. You did the dirty work nobody claps for. Well, I'm clapping.
+ 2 key passes. That pass had more vision than a lighthouse.

WORK ON
- Won 1 of 6 tackles (down from your usual 29%). Mark my words: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- 54% passing (7 of 13). Here's what helps: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
- 0.8 below your typical game. That's an outlier, not an identity.
- Your 4th worst match performance at 6.6. Chin up.
- Cuc United got us 0-2. Heads up, eyes forward.

Teach your feet: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.

Hey, tuxedo_slide. Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

On to the next one. - Coach Lasso
